item.text:
I continued the refactor in the shared-preferences layer. The main change is a new base abstraction in [TermuxPackageAppSharedPreferences.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/settings/preferences/TermuxPackageAppSharedPreferences.java:14), which now owns package-context resolution, shared-preference bootstrap, log-level persistence, and the common multiprocess boolean helpers. I also added [TermuxFontSizeAppSharedPreferences.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/settings/preferences/TermuxFontSizeAppSharedPreferences.java:11) so font-size behavior is shared instead of duplicated.

That let me shrink the concrete wrappers into app-specific shells: [TermuxAppSharedPreferences.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/settings/preferences/TermuxAppSharedPreferences.java:12), [TermuxFloatAppSharedPreferences.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/settings/preferences/TermuxFloatAppSharedPreferences.java:12), [TermuxAPIAppSharedPreferences.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/settings/preferences/TermuxAPIAppSharedPreferences.java:12), [TermuxTaskerAppSharedPreferences.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G005_termux/termux-shared/src/main/java/com/termux/shared/termux/settings/preferences/TermuxTaskerAppSharedPreferences.java:12), and the other plugin preference classes. The result is less repeated code, fewer places to update when preference behavior changes, and cleaner separation between shared behavior and app-specific keys.
